contexts.text: To hide himself from the face of Jehovah () = to fear the dictate, as those are wont to do who are conscious of evil.
Let man no longer believe that his thoughts are hidden...
To hide his flight () = to separate himself, against the will of the other.
They cannot hide (there) what they have thought... Nor can they hide what they have had as ends...
That good hid its power. Signified.
When man is being regenerated, good... hides itself in the interior man...
He wanted to speak to me in private.
To hide... the faces = not to have mercy.
Disposal is effected by removal and hiding; not that the Lord ever... hides His mercy. Explained, Signified.
Hiding. Signified. AC 5962.
The hiding of the celestial Internal. Treated of.
It now treats of the hiding of truth and good...
It then appears to the Angels that the Lord is... hidden from them.
This removal (of good and truth) is meant by the hiding... This hiding... is not effected by the Lord hiding Himself, but by themselves doing so...
The hiding (of the Internal of the Church) in the scientifics of the Church. Signified, Explained.
The covered things of the hidden things of the sand () = the arcana of scientific truths, ( = the spiritual things which lie hidden in the sense of the letter. AE 445:5.)
The falsity which is hidden, Signified. The evil which is hidden. Signified.
In the world this (delight of destroying) is hidden.
The interior man (now) is hidden by most...
(Evils then) are hidden in the interiors...
Although (the Spirits) are in concealment...
This sense is most occult.
From infancy he has learned to hide the desires of his love.
The love of the world... hides (all things of the Church) as beneath a veil.
That the filthy things of man are only hidden...
(The peculiar secrecy of the Quakers.) Explained.
They not only act secretly, but...
The things they believed to lie hidden...
He dare do nothing except in secret.
It is the custom (of the Moravians) to act in secret...
To be hidden beneath the shadow of the wings of God (). Explained.
The hiding of His strength in the horns () = the omnipotence of Divine good through Divine truth; for... in Divine truth lies hidden the omnipotence which is of Divine good.
To hide them in the secret of His faces () = in Divine good, which does not appear before others...

Those who do good and speak truth, not for the sake of self and the world, but for the sake of good itself and truth itself, are meant by those who do alms in secret, and who pray in secret (). Explained.
